peer_results.rationale: While BAC discusses cash and cash equivalents, its primary disclosure (bac_2024_8_D342) focuses on segregated cash required by regulations, and its definition disclosure (bac_2024_8_D017) is a static definition rather than a report on a recent change in presentation or disaggregation of interest-bearing components similar to MS's specific accounting change.

Citi's candidate c_2024_8_D156 defines cash equivalents statically, and c_2024_8_D405 concerns a goodwill transfer, neither of which addresses the presentation change of separating interest-bearing cash from other receivables as seen in the MS disclosure.

comparisons.peer_topic: Definition and composition of cash and cash equivalents
comparisons.peer_summary: The firm defines cash equivalents as highly liquid overnight deposits and reports combined cash and cash equivalents of $182.09 billion as of December 2024, composed of $5.36 billion in cash and due from banks and $176.73 billion in interest-bearing deposits with banks, compared to $241.58 billion in the prior year.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and GS disclose specific changes to the presentation or composition of interest-bearing cash and cash equivalents in recent periods. MS reports that in 2023, it began presenting interest-bearing Cash and cash equivalents separately for the first time, requiring disaggregation of prior year Customer receivables to align with this new presentation. Similarly, GS defines its cash equivalents as highly liquid overnight deposits and reports specific components including 'cash and due from banks' and 'interest-bearing deposits with banks', detailing the balances for these specific categories in its 2024 disclosure, indicating a focus on the granularity of interest-bearing cash components.

sentences.text: 1.In 2023, interest-bearing Cash and cash equivalents and related interest were presented separately for the first time.
The prior year amounts for Customer receivables and Other have been disaggregated to exclude Cash and cash equivalents to align with the current presentation.
The firm defines cash equivalents as highly liquid overnight deposits held in the ordinary course of business.
Cash and cash equivalents included cash and due from banks of $5.36 billion as of December 2024 and $7.93 billion as of December 2023.
Cash and cash equivalents also included interest-bearing deposits with banks of $176.73 billion as of December 2024 and $233.65 billion as of December 2023.

peer_results.rationale: JPM's candidates (jpm_2024_8_D225, jpm_2024_8_D661) discuss the composition of interest-bearing liabilities (brokerage-related customer payables) rather than the presentation or definition changes of interest-bearing assets (cash and equivalents) as the primary focus of the MS disclosure.
